channel.title: Arch Tools Changelog
channel.description: What's new, changed, and fixed in every release of Arch Tools — the first API platform AI agents can pay autonomously.

item.title: v1.11.0 — x402 Ecosystem Launch
item.description:
Added

  • x402 SDK Integration — native x402 payment protocol support with USDC micropayments across 9 blockchain networks
  • Service Directory — curated directory of x402-payable Arch Tools with search, filtering, and x402 payment support
  • Fund Page + Wallet Onboarding — guided wallet setup and funding flow for x402 payments
  • Interactive Playground — live API testing environment with code generation for all tools
  • Framework Integrations — official SDKs for 5 platforms: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, LangChain, CrewAI, and OpenAI Agents
  • Agent Identity (KYA) — Know Your Agent system with verifiable on-chain identity, reputation scoring, and trust metrics
  • Facilitator-as-a-Service — turnkey x402 payment facilitation for third-party API providers
  • Analytics Dashboard — real-time usage analytics with per-tool breakdowns and cost tracking
  • API Documentation Overhaul — comprehensive endpoint reference with interactive examples
  • Competitor Comparison Page — side-by-side feature and pricing comparison

Changed

  • Privacy Policy updated with x402 payment data, agent identity, and directory listing sections
  • Terms of Service expanded with x402 payment terms, facilitator terms, and agent identity terms
  • SEO optimization across all pages
  • Landing page updated with x402 ecosystem messaging

item.title: v1.10.0 — Pricing & Platform Updates
item.description:
Added

  • Pricing restructured: Developer $19/mo, Pro $49/mo, Business $149/mo subscriptions
  • Enterprise tier (Contact Us)
  • 250 free credits on signup (was 100)
  • BYOK for Brave Search, Tavily, and Exa APIs
  • Customer support chatbot
  • Investor page
  • Sentry frontend monitoring
  • Cloudflare CDN + performance optimizations

Changed

  • Image generation credits: 15 → 30 per call
  • Text-to-speech credits: 5 → 10 per call
  • Transcribe audio credits: 8 → 12 per call
  • Annual discount: 25% → 17%

Fixed

  • Sign-out now properly clears session cookie
  • crypto-market-cap no longer 500s on empty body
  • All pages standardized with correct logo + footer

item.title: v1.9.0 — AI Modes, Oracle & Sessions
item.description:
Added

  • AI mode presets: pass mode: "fast" | "smart" | "deep" to ai-generate
  • AI Oracle endpoint (/v1/tools/ai-oracle) — premium reasoning with structured analysis (25 credits)
  • Session API: /v1/tools/session-create and /v1/tools/session-message — managed conversation history
  • Getting Started guide
  • This changelog page
  • JavaScript SDK (@archtools/sdk) — full TypeScript client with retry logic
  • Python SDK (archtools) — complete client with type hints

item.title: v1.8.0 — 63 Tools, MCP Annotations, OAuth 2.1
item.description:
Added

  • 64 production-ready tools (up from 45) — fact-check, news-search, research-report, crypto-sentiment, crypto-ohlcv, token-lookup, crypto-fear-greed, workflow-agent
  • MCP server-card.json with full tool annotations
  • DALL-E 3 image generation
  • ElevenLabs text-to-speech
  • OpenAI Whisper audio transcription
  • Browser automation via Playwright
  • OAuth 2.1 with PKCE + Dynamic Client Registration
  • Comprehensive legal pages

Changed

  • SSE transport upgraded to SSE + Streamable HTTP
  • Improved rate limiting with plan-based tiers (free/pro/business)

Fixed

  • SSRF hardening on web-scrape and browser-task tools
  • Stripe webhook idempotency
  • Registration rate limiting

item.title: v1.0.0 — Initial Release
item.description:
Added

  • Initial release — 38 tools across 13 categories
  • API key authentication with credit-based billing
  • x402 autonomous agent payments (USDC on 9 chains)
  • Stripe integration for human credit purchases
  • MCP server for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and Windsurf
